story: TikTok rolls out Likeness Detection globally, plus a public checker for AI-made videos

sources.name: TikTok Newsroom (en-GB): More tools to provide clarity and control around AI-generated content

source_line: Sources: Music Business Worldwide, RTÉ News (AFP), CTV News (AFP), TikTok Newsroom

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: TikTok's public AI checker needs no account
segments.narration: TikTok's new public checker spots its own AI videos. No account needed.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Likeness Detection is rolling out globally
segments.narration: Likeness Detection is rolling out globally. Eligible creators can flag AI content using their likeness.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Checks Content Credentials and a watermark
segments.narration: The checker reads Content Credentials and an invisible watermark. It misses other AI tools.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: The catch: it's for eligible creators only
segments.narration: The catch: Likeness Detection is only for eligible creators, so check whether you qualify.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Report fakes fast, don't rely on one checker
segments.narration: Our take: report fakes of you fast, and don't trust one checker alone.
